Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: cinematic main-menu background for the browser game SIR ON A MISSION.
Input image 1 is a subject and setting reference, not an edit target. Preserve this man's recognizable facial likeness, age, medium-brown skin, short black hair, round face and serious expression. Preserve his white button-down shirt, black trousers, bright blue/cyan-and-black soft bag, and black phone.
Create one finished wide 1536x1024 semi-realistic hand-painted graphic-novel game illustration. The same man sits in a worn wooden chair at right-center, his blue-black bag resting on his lap, black phone held low in his right hand as in the reference. The character occupies the right half. Warm ochre institutional room with aged plaster wall, wall outlet and cables, desk and papers at the far right, sunbeams and suspended dust. Rich amber light, deep brown shadows, and teal/cyan bag accent. Grounded detailed painting, dramatic but serious cinematic atmosphere, beautiful worn material textures.
Composition requirement: the entire LEFT 45 PERCENT is a quiet dark ochre-brown wall with subtle lighting and texture only, leaving clear space for a title to be added in code. Character, face, chair, phone and bag all on the right; keep the head and bag fully visible. Camera medium-wide, seated full torso and most of legs. No additional people. No rendered typography, no title, no text, no letters, no logo, no UI, no watermark.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent character sprite atlas for a side-scrolling 2D browser game.
Input image 1 is the exact character identity and clothing reference. Preserve this man's recognizable face and likeness, medium-brown skin, short black hair, round face, white button-down shirt, black trousers, black shoes, and his bright cyan/blue-and-black soft shoulder bag. Keep the same character in every pose.
Create a single 1536x1024 PNG sprite atlas on a GENUINELY TRANSPARENT background with real alpha, no background color and no checkerboard. EXACTLY 5 COLUMNS and 2 ROWS of equal-sized invisible cells. Each of the 10 cells contains exactly one isolated full-body character pose. Clean hand-painted semi-realistic graphic-novel game sprite art, lightly outlined forms, warm clothing highlights and brown shadows, vivid cyan-black bag. Side view with enough three-quarter face view to recognize him. All characters face RIGHT.
Cells in row 1 from left to right: 1 idle standing holding bag; 2 walking with left leg forward; 3 running with right leg forward and bag behind; 4 jumping with knees bent; 5 falling with legs extending downward and arms raised for balance.
Cells in row 2 from left to right: 1 ducking low; 2 bag-swing attack with his right arm and blue-black bag clearly extended to the RIGHT; 3 hurt/recoil leaning backward; 4 small victory pose checking his black phone; 5 exhausted, bent forward with hands near knees and bag hanging.
All ten are separate fully visible figures with hands, shoes, head and bag completely within their own cell. Consistent character scale: normal standing character is about 80% of cell height, leaving clean transparent padding on all sides. Crouches retain scale, don't enlarge them. Do not overlap cells. No ground, no environment, no drop shadows beyond the figure, no grid lines, no borders, no labels, no letters, no words, no title, no watermark. Actual transparent background is essential.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: a five-level background atlas for the browser side-scroller SIR ON A MISSION.
Create one finished 1536x2560 environment atlas. EXACTLY FIVE equal horizontal panels, each full width 1536 pixels and exactly 512 pixels tall, stacked vertically with NO borders, no gaps, no text and no characters. Each panel is a different coherent side-on 2D game environment. Use semi-realistic hand-painted graphic-novel illustration, rich cinematic light, detailed architecture and materials, warm amber/brown shadows with teal highlights. It should feel like one art-directed game. No fake pixel art.
Panel 1 at the TOP (y=0 to 511): warm ochre institutional room with cracked plaster, worn wooden chairs only in the distant background, a table, wall socket with cables, angled late-afternoon sunbeams and dust.
Panel 2 (y=512 to 1023): long golden institutional corridor, ceiling strip lights, noticeboards without legible text, several doors, warm directional light.
Panel 3 (y=1024 to 1535): Indian street with ochre shop fronts, one auto-rickshaw parked small in the distant background, chai stall, overhead wires, warm late-afternoon sun. No people or animals.
Panel 4 (y=1536 to 2047): modern office campus foyer in blue and teal, glass walls, turnstiles, elevators, reflected cool architectural light.
Panel 5 at the BOTTOM (y=2048 to 2559): dark surreal clockwork dimension, huge looming clock faces and gears, glowing amber cracks, flying paperwork, mysterious deep blue and brown darkness.
Each panel has a stable side-on 2D game camera, horizon at its own middle, and its own LOWER 20 PERCENT kept visually quiet as a foreground floor band. Distinct horizontal floor plane in each panel. All five panels should be equal height and exactly aligned. Fill the whole canvas. No words, no labels, no typography, no people, no playable characters, no UI, no logos, no watermark.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent production game-prop atlas for SIR ON A MISSION.

Create one 1536x1536 PNG, GENUINELY TRANSPARENT background with real alpha and no background color or checkerboard. Semi-realistic hand-painted graphic-novel game art, clean detailed silhouettes, warm amber highlights, deep brown shadows and vivid blue/teal accents, consistent style across all 16.
Row 1 left to right: a worn wooden classroom chair; a small stack of books; the distinctive soft cyan/blue-and-black bag from the reference; a yellow triangular wet-floor caution sign with icon only and no text.
Row 2 left to right: rolling office chair; broken office printer with glowing red warning light; angry flying document with a subtle illustrated furious face; huge neat stack of office files tied with string.
Row 3 left to right: Indian green-and-yellow auto-rickshaw; friendly brown Indian street dog; simple sturdy bicycle; small glass of amber chai.
Row 4 left to right: glowing teal Wi-Fi signal power-up symbol; collectible gold document with folded corner and decorative lines but no letters; sinister round alarm clock boss with bell ears and angry clock face; dark wall-mounted office meeting door shown front-on with an ominous small window, no wall extending outside the door frame.
Every prop entirely inside its own padded cell, centered, clean edges, no overlap, no cropping. Use padding of about 10% around each prop. No grid, no border, no labels, no title, no letters, no words, no logo, no watermark. No rendered environment or ground. Preserve actual alpha transparency.
